programme.title: Christine Nonbo Andersen, Tuva Semmingsen, David Bateson & Steffen Bruun
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: Flying Over Iceland
programme.desc: Flying Over Iceland: Part I is a stunning yet soothing aerial journey to the remote fjiords and valleys of eastern Iceland. The first of a series of 1 hour films, Part I begins at sunrise on a perfect summer day in Breiðdalsvík, where a golden sun lights up the majestic valley. After soaring through the golden sea mists and offering a glimpse of the stunning Breiðdalur Valley (its name means ‘Wide Valley'), viewers then head inland to a hidden, magical arched waterfall for a refreshing immersive flight that begins at the base of the falls and reaches above the clouds. Next, as the morning turns into a sunlit afternoon, viewers are swept inland to the crystal clear waters of the the impressive Breiðdalsá river, to cool off in some falls along with a pair of local swans. Well known for salmon fishing, the turquoise blue river winds its way scenically across the valley basin to the sea, which is where the film ends - but not before a chance encounter with a local reindeer! The final flight in Part 1 offers a sunny afternoon look at the tiny village of Breiðdalsvík from afar and offers amazing blue water vistas of with green islands, seagulls, a rock island that that looks like a cat, a scenic lighthouse, and more.

When Evan realises that by reading his diaries he can unlock the past and go back in time, he tries to reclaim the missing memories by tampering with the past... with unexpected and disastrous results! The more Evan tampers with time, the more his life - and that of his friend Kayleigh (Amy Smart) - begin to unravel, and he discovers there is no such thing as a happy ending!

programme.title: Love's Sweet Recipe

programme.title: Abduction of Angie

programme.title: Alter

programme.title: One Christmas Eve

programme.title: Little Women (1994)
programme.desc: Winona Ryder lights up the screen in this classic story of love and family devotion.

programme.title: On Strike For Christmas
programme.desc: Sick of being taken for granted by her husband Stephen (David Sutcliffe) and her sons, Joy Robertson (Daphne Zuniga) organizes a holiday protest which quickly earns the supportof most of the women in town.

programme.title: This Christmas
programme.desc: This year, Christmas with the Whitfield's promises to be one they will never forget. All the siblings have come home for the first time in years and they've brought plenty of baggage with them. As the Christmas tree is trimmed and the lights are hung, secrets are revealed and family bonds are tested. As their lives converge, they join together and help each other discover the true meaning of family.

programme.title: Big Mommas: Like Father, Like Son
programme.desc: Big Momma is back — and this time he has big backup: his teenage stepson Trent (Brendan T. Jackson). Martin Lawrence returns as FBI agent Malcolm Turner and as Turner's deep-cover alter-ego Big Momma.

programme.title: Lars and the real girl
programme.desc: Extremely shy Lars strikes up an unconventional relationship with a doll he finds on the Internet. On the advice of a doctor, his family and neighbours go along with his delusion.

programme.title: The Internship
programme.desc: Billy (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Owen Wilson) are salesmen whose careers have been torpedoed by the digital world. Trying to prove they are not obsolete, they defy the odds by talking their way into a coveted internship at Google, along with a battalion of brilliant college students.

programme.title: I Feel Pretty
programme.desc: A woman struggling with insecurity wakes from a fall believing she is the most beautiful woman on the planet. Her new confidence empowers her to live fearlessly, but what happens when she realizes her appearance never changed?

programme.title: Kill Django... Kill First
programme.desc: In a mining town, Johnny MaGee clashes with banker Anthony Burton, who uses bandits and deceit to seize gold mines and control the economy. Partnering with an old miner, Johnny seeks justice, while navigating love, betrayal, and alliances. As tensions rise, a bounty hunter joins the fray, promising a final showdown against corruption.

programme.title: Border Shootout
programme.desc: Young rancher Kirby Frye is appointed deputy in a small town tyrannized by ruthless Phil Sundeen, the son of one of the founders of the town.

programme.title: I Am Sartana, Trade Your Guns for a Coffin
programme.desc: Sartana, a bounty hunter and gunfighter, witnesses a gold robbery and arrives in a suspicious town run by Samuel Spencer. Hired to protect the next shipment, Sartana fends off numerous incompetent villains, surviving their attempts on his life. Meanwhile, his nemesis, Sabbath—known for his white coat and parasol—arrives in town. With tensions rising, Sartana and Sabbath are headed for a final showdown to settle the score.

programme.title: Killer Caliber 32
programme.desc: Hired gun Silver kills a masked gang's seven members one by one, using silver bullets and his own code of justice. Between poker games and saloon girls, his mission leads to the dramatic unmasking of the gang's ruthless leader. Silver's style and honor make him a deadly force in this action-packed tale.

programme.title: Robbery Under Arms
programme.desc: Two brothers join their father in Captain Starlight's bush ranger gang in 19th Century Australia.

programme.title: And Then There Were None
programme.desc: Gathered at a manor house on an isolated island by an unknown host, guests are killed off one-by-one.

programme.title: The Importance Of Being Earnest
programme.desc: Complications arise when Jack and Algernon pass themselves off as each other.

programme.title: The Bargee
programme.desc: Hemel's adventures with irascible lock-keeper Hugh Griffith and skirmishes with boating playboy Eric Sykes.

programme.title: Black Sheep of Whitehall
programme.desc: The Harrow Correspondence College - Principal, Professor William Davis - differs from its more notable namesake in more than one respect, and in no greater respect than size. It possesses only one pupil, and he hasn't paid his fees. When Professor Davis visits the pupil, a young assistant in the press division of the Ministry of International Commerce, in an effort to extract the unpaid fee from him, he becomes involved in a hilarious series of misadventures with kidnapped professors and Nazi plots, and culminating in a crazy car chase involving a baby carriage and a bath chair.

programme.title: Wages of Sydney
programme.desc: Quan Shu, Manchuria 1359 BC: The Chinese invent an explosive gift egg. New York, 2001: A rival beats Sydney and Nigel to a map leading to the Dragon's Egg.

programme.title: Vampires Kiss
programme.desc: Lucas Blackmer, a babe-magnet, professor and a novelist asks Sydney to help find Vlad Tepes' lost relic. And he isn't the only one after it.

programme.title: Mr. Right

programme.title: Sydney at Ten
programme.desc: Sydney's roommate from school is on track of a pendant from her past and enlists Sydney to help find it and catch the killer.

programme.title: The Light of Truth
programme.desc: Arabia 843 AD: A sheik uses the Light of Truth to reveal his general as a traitor. 2001: Prince Shareem drops out from Sydney's class to go search for the Light of Truth.

programme.title: Treasure Island
programme.desc: Sydney's on the hunt for a Pirate's booty, but will a traitor force her to walk the plank?

programme.title: Women Want to Know
programme.desc: Sydney has found a temple with an idol of Ganesha and it is being filmed for TV, but they get trapped inside when the local rebels stumble onto them. Can Nigel and Karen help from USA?

programme.title: The Star of Nadir
programme.desc: An anonymous Sultan's wife Danielle dies in mysterious circumstances in the desert. However, she had called for Sydney to help. Sydney believes Danielle was searching for the Star of Nadir.

programme.title: Samaritan
programme.desc: Twenty years ago, Granite City's hometown hero, Samaritan, was reported dead after a fiery warehouse battle with his rival, Nemesis. Most in the city believe he perished in the fire, but one young boy holds out hope that Samaritan still lives!

programme.title: The Fountain
programme.desc: Two immortally linked souls transcend the boundaries of time and space, one desperately searching for the answers that will save the other, and deliver the promise of eternal life.

programme.title: Saints & Soliders 2: Airborne Creed
programme.desc: On August 15th 1944, the 517th Parachute Regimental Combat Team (PRCT) jumped over the south of France. In their effort to complete the mission and rendezvous with their unit, three isolated paratroopers come across a group of French resistants in desperate need.

programme.title: A Perfect Plan
programme.desc: Four notorious thieves wake up in a fortified warehouse and are forced to commit an audacious diamond heist to win their freedom.

programme.title: The Art Of The Steal
programme.desc: Renowned art thief and former daredevil Crunch Calhoun (Kurt Russell) teams up with a motley crew of international grifters to pull off the most elaborate double-crossing caper of a lifetime.

programme.title: Enough

After the arrival of their first child, her picture perfect life is shattered when she discovers Mitch's hidden possessive dark side, a controlling and abusive alter ego that can turn trust, loveand tranquility into terror.

programme.title: Secret Window

programme.title: Tears of the Sun

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Animal Factory [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Suburbanite Ron (Edward Furlong) is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid.

programme.title: A Dark Place
programme.desc: When a young boy goes missing in a sleepy backwoods town, a local sanitation truck driver, Donald, plays detective, embarking on a precarious and obsessive investigation.

programme.title: Spotlight [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 2001, editor Marty Baron of The Boston Globe assigns a team of journalists to investigate allegations against John Geoghan, an unfrocked priest accused of molesting more than 80 boys. Led by editor Walter "Robby" Robinson (Michael Keaton), reporters Michael Rezendes (Mark Ruffalo), Matt Carroll and Sacha Pfeiffer interview victims and try to unseal sensitive documents. The reporters make it their mission to provide proof of a cover-up of sexual abuse within the Roman Catholic Church.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Derailed [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Secret agent Kristoff (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is assigned to escort Galina Konstantin (Laura Elena Harring), a thief in possession of a deadly virus, on a train journey that unluckily falls on his birthday. Kristoff tells his disappointed wife, son and daughter that he's taking a business trip. They decide to sneak aboard the train as a surprise, only to suspect he's having an affair with the mysterious Galina. To make matters much worse, terrorists hijack the train and go after the virus.

programme.title: Dog Soldiers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: During a routine nighttime training mission in the Scottish Highlands, a small squad of British soldiers expected to rendezvous with a special ops unit instead find a bloody massacre with a sole survivor. The savage attackers of the special ops team return, and the men are rescued by Megan, a zoologist who identifies what hunts them as werewolves. Without transport or communications, the group is forced to retreat to a farmhouse to wait for the full moon to disappear at dawn.

programme.title: Avalanche (1999)
programme.desc: The survivor of an Alaskan avalanche, Dr. Lia Freeman (Caroleen Feeney) is an environmentalist concerned about a similar disaster occurring if a proposed new oil pipeline is built. Freeman adamantly warns the planners of the likelihood of a major avalanche, but they ignore her pleas. As she realizes that a massive whiteout is imminent, Freeman tries to get the citizens of a nearby town to leave, aided by brave helicopter pilot Neal Meekin (Thomas Ian Griffith).

programme.title: John Lee Hooker, Carey Bell, Jimmy Dawkins & Joe Harper
programme.sub-title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar). From the first to the very last minute of the concert, Hooker illustrates why he, 45 years later, was to be ranked 35th on Rolling Stone's 2015 list of 100 Greatest Guitarists: this bluesman is truly in a class of his own.

programme.title: Seasick Steve
programme.desc: Steven Gene Wold, commonly known as Seasick Steve, (born circa 1941) is an American bluesman, although he prefers to be called "a song and dance man". He plays guitars (mostly personalized), and sings, usually about his early life living rough and doing casual work.

programme.title: Gil Evans & Ornette Coleman
programme.sub-title: Gil Evans, Ornette Coleman - Schloss Ansbach
programme.desc: This program presents two concerts from Schloss Ansbach in 1978. The first concert features Gil Evans and his orchestra, consisting of Gil Evans on piano, Steve Lacy on soprano saxophone, Arthur Blythe on alto saxophone, Pit Levin on synthesizers, Earl McIntyre on trombone, Lewis Soloff on trumpet, Geoffrey Berlin on bass and Sue Evans on percussion instruments. The second concert features saxophonist Ornette Coleman at the peak of his musically expressive powers. Coleman is joined by Bern Nix on guitar, Charles Ellerbee on guitar, Albert Arnold on bass, and Shannon Jackson on drums and percussion.

programme.title: Raul Midón
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017's Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón's performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound. He has worked with numerous legends, including Bill Withers, Herbie Hancock, Sting, and Dianne Reeves, and his album ‘Bad Ass and Blind' was nominated for a Grammy Award for Best Jazz Vocal Album in 2018. No wonder the Sing Jazz audience were ecstatic!

programme.title: Ron Carter
programme.desc: Ron Carter, Bobby Hutcherson and Joe Chambers are legends of Blue Note Records. They have established themselves as forward-thinking and inventive band leaders, composers and studio musicians, astonishing audiences around the world with their creativity and technical versatility.

programme.title: John Scofield
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1986, multi-talented American guitarist John Scofield and his band performed an electrifying concert at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. First known for playing with Miles Davis, Scofield shows here that he earned that pedigree.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jo Jones & Milt Buckner
programme.sub-title: Jo Jones & Milt Buckner - Radio Télévision Suisse
programme.desc: In early September 1969, the duo of American drummer ‘Papa' Jo Jones (1911–1985) and American organist Milt Buckner (1915–1977) played a string of jazz concerts in Switzerland. Jo Jones, who pioneered playing timekeeping rhythms on a cymbal rather than the bass drum, became renowned in the 1930s in the Count Basie Orchestra. Milt Buckner rose to prominence as a pianist in the Lionel Hampton Orchestra in the 1940s, yet devoted himself to the organ in the 1950s. Swiss actor Jean Landier welcomed the two musicians to the Radio Télévision Suisse program ‘Variétés: Jasons Jazz' for a short interview, followed by performances of ‘Hamp's Boogie Woogie', ‘Georgia Mae', ‘Tea For Two', and ‘Flying Home'.

programme.title: Tim Weiss, Arctic Philharmonic, Berit Norbakken Solset & Øystein Moen
programme.sub-title: Glass - A Descent into the Maelström
programme.desc: ‘A Descent into the Maelström' (1841) is American writer Edgar Allan Poe's short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, inside the Arctic Circle of northern Norway. After a treacherous whirlpool drags their boat down, only one of them survives. American composer Philipp Glass based his choral work for the Australian Dance Theatre on this story. The piece was performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. Beacon Isle Films recorded an arrangement of Glass's work for symphony orchestra, performed by the Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra and Choir conducted by Tim Weiss. Soprano Berit Norbakken Solset is the soloist. The Artic Philharmonic Orchestra is the world's youngest and northernmost professional orchestral institution, presenting circa 150 performances and concerts each year. This 2019 recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten's spectacular landscape: the very surroundings that inspired Poe's story.

programme.title: Rodolfo Mederos, Otros Aires, Teresa Parodi & Café de los Maestros
programme.desc: For the audience in the famous ballroom El Palacio in Buenos Aires, the year 2012 began with tango rhythms and Argentinean folk music. This festive broadcast opens with a tango performance by dance partners Eduardo and Gloria, accompanied by the renowned ensemble Café de los Maestros. Another highlights is a performance by bandoneon player Rodolfo Mederos and his trio. In addition, the concert features a performance by Teresa Parodi, former lead singer of the Astor Piazzolla Band, accompanied by the Fernando Suárez Paz Quintet. Also on the bill is the contemporary electronic tango formation Otros Aires. Founded by Miguel Di Genova in 2003, Otros Aires combines electronic rhythms and traditional tango instruments, such as the bandoneon, piano, and guitar. On the program are compositions by Astor Piazzolla, Pedro Maffia, Pedro Laurenz, Gustavo Mozzi, and many others. Enjoy this concert of music and dance, featuring some of Argentine's tango scene's finest artists!

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky
programme.sub-title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. Lugansky opens his concert with Beethoven's Piano Sonata No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 2, ‘Moonlight', followed by Alexander Glazunov's Piano Sonata No. 2 in E minor, Op. 75. Then Lugansky performs a selection of works by Rachmaninoff: Rachmaninoff's piano transcription of J. S. Bach's Partita No. 3 in E major a selection of Études-Tableaux (Nos. 1, 2, 4, and 8, Op, 33, and Nos. 5 and 6, Op. 39) Lilac (Op. 21, No. 5) Prelude in C minor, Op. 23 No. 7 and Rachmaninoff's transcription of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Lullaby (Op. 16 No. 1). This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on June 4, 2021.

programme.title: Christine Nonbo Andersen, Tuva Semmingsen, David Bateson & Steffen Bruun
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: Slipknot
programme.desc: After more than a decade of patiently waiting, the Mexican Maggots finally welcome the most anticipated visit of Slipknot and Knotfest to Mexico. On December 8th, 2015, Knotfest took over Mexico City for the experience of a lifetime. The most passionate, powerful, dedicated and loud Maggots on Earth attended in hordes to witness in action their most inspirational figures: the 9 members of Slipknot. The band did not disappoint. This show will leave you speechless and craving more. The intensity of Slipknot and the love they have for their fans is palpable. The wait was well worth it.

programme.title: Flying Over Iceland
programme.desc: Flying Over Iceland: Part I is a stunning yet soothing aerial journey to the remote fjiords and valleys of eastern Iceland. The first of a series of 1 hour films, Part I begins at sunrise on a perfect summer day in Breiðdalsvík, where a golden sun lights up the majestic valley. After soaring through the golden sea mists and offering a glimpse of the stunning Breiðdalur Valley (its name means ‘Wide Valley'), viewers then head inland to a hidden, magical arched waterfall for a refreshing immersive flight that begins at the base of the falls and reaches above the clouds. Next, as the morning turns into a sunlit afternoon, viewers are swept inland to the crystal clear waters of the the impressive Breiðdalsá river, to cool off in some falls along with a pair of local swans. Well known for salmon fishing, the turquoise blue river winds its way scenically across the valley basin to the sea, which is where the film ends - but not before a chance encounter with a local reindeer! The final flight in Part 1 offers a sunny afternoon look at the tiny village of Breiðdalsvík from afar and offers amazing blue water vistas of with green islands, seagulls, a rock island that that looks like a cat, a scenic lighthouse, and more.

De cuidarlo se encarga una joven enfermera llamada Albine, sobrina de un conocido ateo llamado Jeanbernat. Serge y Albine se enamoran y todo parece marchar bien hasta que Serge recobra la memoria y se da cuenta de la gravedad de su pecado.

En una base militar en la Inglaterra rural, se estudia a estos niños, que son capaces de pensar y sentir aún estar infectados, en la búsqueda de una cura. Melanie es una niña muy especial, que destaca del resto. Pronto decidirá su propio futuro y el de la raza humana.

programme.title: Christmas in Conway
programme.desc: Suzy acaba de volver del hospital y necesita cuidados las 24 horas del día. Su marido, Duncan, decide que la mejor medicina para Suzy podría ser un regalo de Navidad que nunca olvidará: subirse a una noria instalada en su propio jardín. ¿Por qué una noria? Porque fue en una noria cuando hace muchas lunas Duncan pidió a Suzy que se casara con él.

programme.title: En busca de la Navidad
programme.desc: Después de años de perderse las reuniones familiares, Whitney Kennison viaja a Chicago para pasar Navidad con su abuela Frances. Emocionada porque su nieta está en casa para las fiestas, Frances le regala los preciados adornos navideños de la familia Kennison. Pero cuando Whitney los tira por error, Frances debe idear una búsqueda del tesoro navideña para recordarle el significado de las fiestas.

programme.title: One Christmas Eve
programme.desc: Una serie de contratiempos amenaza los intentos de una madre recién divorciada de brindar una perfecta primera Navidad a sus dos hijos ''sin padre'.

programme.title: Vaya Navidades
programme.desc: Este año parece que los Whitfield tendrán una Navidad inolvidable. Por primera vez en años, todos los hermanos vinieron a casa, trajeron mucho equipaje. Mientras adornan el árbol de Navidad y cuelgan las luces, se revelan los secretos y el vínculo de la familia es puesto a prueba. programme.title: Perseguido
programme.desc: Huérfano tras el asesinato de su familia, Jeb es criado en un rancho, pero su pasado lo persigue. Enamorado de su hermana adoptiva y enfrentado a su hermano, también es acechado por un misterioso tío que busca venganza. A pesar de convertirse en héroe de guerra, Jeb lucha contra enemigos ocultos y un destino trágico en el salvaje Oeste.

programme.title: Daniel Boone, juicio de fuego
programme.desc: Daniel Boone conduce a los colonos a Kentucky, pero debe luchar contra los indios Shawnee que han sido convencidos por un renegado francés de que Boone y los colonos están allí para matarlos y robarles sus tierras.

programme.title: Death Alley
programme.desc: En 1892, Los hermanos Dalton se proponen convertirse en los forajidos más famosos de Estados Unidos. Ese sueño se convertiría en una pesadilla.

programme.title: Texas Lady
programme.desc: Una mujer de cabeza fuerte del Este hereda un periódico en un pequeño pueblo de Texas donde los barones del ganado locales, que controlan la región, quieren quitársela de encima.

programme.title: La fiebre de la pradera
programme.desc: Un grupo de mujeres contrae una extraña fiebre y un antiguo sheriff se encarga de llevarlas al hospital de la ciudad más cercana, pero en su camino se encontrarán con una peligrosa banda de asesinos.

programme.title: La muerte juega a los dados
programme.desc: Cuatro compañeros de trabajo van a hacer una barbacoa en una isla. Después de emborracharse, uno de ellos muere accidentalmente en un juego. Mientras intentaba deshacerse del cuerpo, el ayudante de su trabajo llega inesperadamente a la isla.

programme.title: Executor
programme.desc: Un despiadado asesino, entrenado para matar en nombre de Dios por un sacerdote corrupto, reevalúa el propósito de su vida después de salvar a un niño pequeño de uno de sus propios intentos de asesinato.

programme.title: El Chata
programme.desc: Aunque Samuel tiene talento de sobra para ser campeón de boxeo, parece destinado a recibir golpes como un saco de boxeo. Ahora, a sus treinta años, tiene que convertirse en sparring porque nadie está dispuesto a darle una oportunidad. Joe, su antiguo entrenador, que está entrenando a una nueva promesa, decide ponerle a prueba. Incapaz de alimentar a su familia y con las tentaciones encima, en lo único que puede pensar es en volver al ring y demostrarse a sí mismo y a todo el mundo, que el tiempo en prisión le ha cambiado, y que está decidido a recuperar a su familia y ganarse de nuevo el cariño de su hijo. De vuelta ya al barrio, la vida no le deja quitarse los guantes ni un segundo. Aunque la posibilidad de emigrar la ve como un renacer, Samuel sabe que, vaya donde vaya, el barrio siempre está dentro de uno.

programme.title: Yo te quiero más
programme.desc: Neycy, joven cubana con sueños rotos, emigra hacia México en busca de libertad, pero cae en las redes de Mario, quien la explota bajo falsas promesas. Entre miseria y dignidad, lucha por cumplir sus sueños. Nueva producción de Andariego Films con Producciones Parabolum.

programme.title: La Guarida del Lobo
programme.desc: Vicente ha sido herido y Toco lo acoge en su cabaña. El cambio en la pacífica relación que mantenían es provocado por un personaje que quiere las tierras de Toco. Pronto se desata el conflicto y se revelan secretos inesperados.

programme.title: El club de los incomprendidos
programme.desc: A Valeria le ha cambiado la vida por completo. La separación de sus padres la ha llevado a trasladarse a Madrid con su madre. Eso supone muchas cosas nuevas. Casa, instituto, amigos…La cosa se complica todavía más cuando Valeria se ve obligada a asistir al grupo de terapia que organiza el psicólogo del instituto. Allí se encontrará con otros compañeros que también se ven obligados a ir pero lo que parece un mal comienzo paralajoven adolescente, no es más que el inicio de una increíble experiencia vital nuevos amigos, una ciudad llena de posibilidades, acariciar la madurez y sobre todo descubrir que el primer amor es bastante más complicado de lo que se dice en loscuentos de princesas.

programme.title: La abeja Maya. La película
programme.desc: La curiosa abeja Maya y su amigo Willy salvarán a la colmena de la avaricia del consejero de la reina y pondrán fin a años de hostilidad entre abejas y avispas. Maya es una abeja recién nacida muy vivaracha que no sigue las reglas de la colmena, entre ellas la de no confiar en las avispas que viven más allá de la pradera. Cuando desaparece la jalea real, las avispas son las principales sospechosas y las abejas señalan a Maya como cómplice del robo. Ninguna de sus compañeras cree en su inocencia y Willy, su mejor amigo, será su único apoyo. Juntos se embarcarán en un largo viaje lleno de aventuras hasta la colmena de las avispas para encontrar al verdadero culpable. Gracias a Maya y Willy por fin reinará la amistad entre todos los residentes de la opulenta pradera.

programme.title: Momo: Una aventura contrarreloj
programme.desc: Momo es una niña tímida y cariñosa que ha encontrado nuevos amigos y una casa en medio de las ruinas de un antiguo anfiteatro. Pero un día, repentinamente, los Hombres Grises irrumpen en la ciudad, con el objetivo de robar el tiempo a la gente. Momo desearía impedírselo, pero no sabe como… Casiopea, una pequeña tortuga mágica, la lleva a conocer al Maestro Hora, el Administrador del tiempo. Él es la única persona que puede ayudarla. Cuando regresa para luchar contra los Hombres Grises, se da cuenta de que ya no hay nadie con quien hablar o jugar y teme haber perdido para siempre a sus amigos. El mundo ha cambiado y todos han sido englobados en una nueva y rígida estructura social… A pesar de su repentina soledad, está decidida a intentar lo imposible para salvar a sus amigos y a la ciudad entera.

programme.title: El callejón
programme.desc: En una noche invernal, Rosa se ve obligada a hacer la colada en una lavandería situada en un oscuro y desierto callejón. Allí sufrirá el acoso de un asesino en serie que la someterá al sádico juego del ratón y el gato.

programme.title: El regreso de Aladino
programme.desc: Después de liberar a Bagdad de las garras de su terrible visir, Aladin está aburrido en palacio. Todavía no ha decidido pedir matrimonio a la princesa. Pero un terrible dictador, Shah Zaman, se invita al Palacio y anuncia que ha venido a tomar la ciudad y casarse con la Princesa. Aladin no tiene más remedio que huir del Palacio. Intentará recuperar a su antiguo Genio y así, volver para liberar a la ciudad y salvar a su novia.

programme.title: En temporada baja
programme.desc: Sigue la supuesta camaradería formada por Alberto, "el crack", quien fue un exitoso representante de futbolistas que ahora vive en un camping a las afueras de Valencia, y Charly, un policía divorciado que duerme en el trabajo.

programme.title: Cuando todo esté en orden
programme.desc: Una película honesta y sentida sobre las relaciones entre padres e hijos y la devastación que suponen las drogas.

programme.title: Swing, la vida de un secreto
programme.desc: Para animar su vida sexual, una joven opta por ir con su novio a un club de intercambio de parejas. La aventura le llevará a descubrir un sorprendente secreto familiar.

programme.title: Anita no pierde el tren
programme.desc: Anita ve como derriban el cine en el que trabaja como taquillera. A partir de ese día su vida cambia.

programme.title: Raw Meat
programme.desc: When a government official disappears in the London tunnels, after several reports of missing people in the same location, Scotland Yard start to take the matter seriously,

programme.title: Dead Man's Cards
programme.desc: Ex-boxer Tom is on the ropes. His career is over, his marriage is on the rocks and he's broke. When a chance encounter leads to the offer of work, the jury is out on whether he is on the road to redemption or if he will hit the self-destruct button.

programme.title: Point Defiance
programme.desc: A bachelor's beautiful, isolated home becomes a hostile prison when his troubled brother returns from military duty in Afghanistan, forcing them to unearth their violent past before another dark secret is buried.

programme.title: Myway
programme.desc: Cuando un maton de poca monta arruina un negocio de drogas, se encuentra en problemas con algunos jefes de la mafia muy peligrosos, sin mencionar a su propia esposa e hija. Este crudo drama criminal sigue al gangster mientras intenta corregir sus dos desastres.

programme.title: Avalanche Sharks
programme.desc: Después de una terrible avalancha, el personal de Twin Pines Resort Sky comienza a recibir informes sobre personas que han desaparecido y criaturas que se mueven bajo la nieve.

programme.title: Piel
programme.desc: Un notorio skinhead se enamora de una mujer y sus tres hijas, y se somete a dolorosos tratamientos para eliminar los tatuajes que cubren todo su rostro y cuerpo, la representación física del odio que mostró al mundo durante más de la mitad de su vida. Basada en la historia real de Bryon Widner.

programme.title: Blood Lake
programme.desc: Después de devorar a la población de peces, miles de lampreas hambrientas comienzan a atacar a los ciudadanos de una tranquila ciudad lacustre, y la comunidad lucha por mantenerse con vida.

programme.title: La espada del asesino
programme.desc: Nguyen Vu es el único sobreviviente de su familia que fue ejecutada por la emperatriz de Vietnam. Descubre que tal atrocidad fue motivada tras ser acusados por delitos que no cometieron y se propone hacer justicia y limpiar su nombre.

programme.title: Rescate en Afganistán
programme.desc: Un comando de las operaciones especiales, liderado por el experto francotirador Jake Chandler, es enviado a un poblado de Afganistan para rescatar a un congresista capturado por los talibanes. La misión es un éxito, pero Jake, se queda en el campo de batalla para salvar a un soldado herido.

programme.title: Valentine, venganza oscura
programme.desc: La tranquila ciudad de Batavia ya no es lo que era. La violencia, los robos y la gran tasa de criminalidad hacen de sus calles un lugar inhabitable. En medio de ese caos vive Srimaya, una joven aspirante a actriz que, acabará convirtiéndose en una superheroína para acabar con el crimen de la ciudad.

programme.title: Comando War Pigs
programme.desc: Al Capitán de la Segunda Guerra Mundial Jack Wosick, se le da la oportunidad de redimirse cuando se le designa para dirigir una unidad variopinta de soldados inadaptados conocidos como los “War Pigs”.

programme.title: Indomable
programme.desc: Estilizado y contundente thriller de acción de Steven Soderbergh. La hermosa Mallory Kane es una joven soldado contratada por numerosos gobiernos para realizar tareas que ellos mismos no podrían llevar a cabo... Se le encomienda una misión donde es traicionada. Ahora sólo planea su venganza.

programme.title: Caza Terrorista
programme.desc: Un agente de la CIA se ve obligado a abandonar el servicio activo a consecuencia de una paulatina pérdida de memoria.

programme.title: Viking
programme.desc: Vladimir el Grande unifica tribus eslavas.

programme.title: Amenaza Terrorista
programme.desc: Un agente británico debe localizar y eliminar a un terrorista suicida y a su célula nacida en el país.

programme.title: Boone: El cazarrecompensas
programme.desc: Un caza-recompensas intenta capturar a un cabecilla de la droga pero descubre más de lo que buscaba.

programme.title: Vlad, el Empalador
programme.desc: Siete guerreros luchan contra Vlad “El Empalador” para salvar a su pueblo en una épica batalla final.

programme.title: Anaconda 3: La Amenaza
programme.desc: En un centro de investigación en un bosque europeo, un brillante científico está realizando esperimentos con dos colosales serpientes. Pero cuando el hombre de negocios que financia todo, lleva el experimento demasiado lejos, las serpientes escapan, hambrientas y dirigiéndose hacia la civilización.

programme.title: Life: Vida
programme.desc: LIFE: VIDA es un aterrador thriller de ciencia ficción sobre un grupo de científicos a bordo de la Estación Espacial Internacional, cuya misión de reconocimiento acaba sumida en el pánico cuando descubren una forma de vida extraterrestre que evoluciona rápidamente y que ha causado la extinción en Marte. Ahora, amenaza a la tripulación y a toda la vida sobre la Tierra.

programme.title: Abismo
programme.desc: Gail Berke y David Sanders están pasando unas idílicas vacaciones en las Bermudas. Mientras practican submarinismo, de repente, se topan con los restos del naufragio de un buque de carga de la segunda Guerra Mundial, en cuyo interior hallan miles de ampollas de morfina. Este descubrimiento los lleva a ponerse en contacto con un traficante haitiano y un buscador de tesoros
